headline: Brent above $110 on Gulf and Iran shipping attacks and a 10-year yield near 5.1% keep markets on edge ahead of next week's FOMC, GDP/PCE and mega-cap earnings.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield is about 5.1% (peak near 5.3% earlier in October) and the 2-year hit about 4.77% this week, with cuts priced out for 2026.
fed: The Fed is in its blackout period before the Oct 28 FOMC (2:00 PM ET), where a hold is expected (about 94% of economists) and a December hike is widely expected.
oil: Brent was about $110 and WTI about $98 on Oct 22 after Houthi attacks on Saudi targets, a US diplomatic drawdown in Saudi Arabia and repeated Hormuz shipping attacks.
geo: Iran and Gulf escalation risk is active: Hormuz and Gulf of Oman shipping attacks and the US ordering some diplomats out of Saudi Arabia, with possible renewed US/Israel action on Iran reported.

events.name: Q3 GDP advance and September PCE
